$comment: The ad-page fold set, measured off GW-Ads-Library on 2026-09-22.
WHAT IS MEASURED HERE. Node ids, frame names, the Desktop/Phone variant split and
every width and height came back from the Figma metadata API and are node-traceable.
TOKEN BINDINGS are measured too, and live in the sibling variables.json — read with
the variable API, so they say what each node is ATTACHED to rather than what a
generated stylesheet happened to emit. What is still not measured is the LAYOUT
that arranges those tokens, which is why a fold is shown as its Figma render
THIS IS A SECOND ADS FILE. Memory and DECISIONS record the ads Figma as
O6g05YAT980r85VaDQha4h. This is t9rRxJODIVZ4N6CnrGdMhC, GW-Ads-Library, and it is the
one Utsav pointed at. Which of the two is authoritative is an open question, not
something this file should answer by picking one silently.
`order` is the composition of the page that actually shipped —
web/internal/staging/ai-crm-lander — read off its own section comments, not decided
here. Two folds in that order have no component in this library and come from the main
web set instead; they carry "library": "web" and are the finding, not an omission.

reference.navbar: logo + blue Book a Demo only — no nav links, no hamburger
reference.note: Still in flight. Not listed on web/internal/staging.html.

components.name: Atoms / Eyebrow / Ad Page

components.name: Folds / Hero / Primary

components.name: Folds / Video
components.note: The lander builds this as fold/ other rather than instancing a video fold.

components.name: Folds / Features
components.note: Four alternating text/image rows. The tallest fold in the set at both breakpoints.

components.name: Folds / Timeline / CRM Setup
components.note: Four steps in a row on desktop, stacked on phone — 520 to 1156, the biggest reflow in the set.

components.name: Footers / With CTA

components.name: Footers / Minimal
components.note: 44px at both breakpoints — the only component in the set that does not reflow.
